summary: Implemented the programmatic live Rerun flashlight example and added rerun-sdk==0.32.2 to the examples optional dependency group only.
work_completed: Added examples/flashlight/run_programmatic_rerun.py with a top-level LightCommand dataclass and compute_light_command hook initialized from CLI light defaults.

The new script uses rendering_service.get_current_viewport_desc() on each capture tick, aligns BP_CameraSensor captures to the live viewport pose, updates a movable ASpotLight at the viewport camera with enabled/intensity/yaw/pitch command values, streams RGB/depth/normals/albedo/camera pose/trajectory/light status to Rerun, prints compact per-tick terminal status, and cleans up spawned actors/components/SPEAR on exit.
Added CLI options for map/map-path, movement speed, scene-light disabling, light defaults, width, height, capture FPS, Rerun app id, and disabling viewer spawn.
Added a clear missing-rerun install hint.
Updated python/pyproject.toml examples extras with rerun-sdk==0.32.2 and left core dependencies unchanged.
Verification run: TOML dependency placement check passed; rerun-sdk==0.32.2 is in examples extras and absent from core dependencies.

Verification run: isolated rerun-sdk==0.32.2 API smoke test passed for rr.init, rr.set_time, rr.Image, rr.DepthImage, rr.Scalars, rr.TextDocument, rr.Transform3D, rr.Points3D, rr.LineStrips3D, rr.Arrows3D, rr.Pinhole, and rr.ViewCoordinates.
Verification run: mocked import plus log_rerun_frame smoke test passed in the isolated Rerun environment.
